title: Habit Substitution Success Rate
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vice:log
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(eval(if(action="resisted",1,0))) as resisted, sum(eval(if(action="gave_in",1,0))) as gave_in by _time
| eval success=round(100*resisted/(resisted+gave_in),1)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how often you resisted an urge versus gave in each day, measuring the willpower behind breaking a habit.
value: A daily success rate turns the fuzzy struggle of quitting into a metric you can watch improve.
implementation: Log resisted and gave-in moments into `index=personal`; trend the daily resist rate.
visualization: Line chart of daily urge-resisting success rate.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how often you resisted a craving versus gave in, showing your willpower getting stronger over time.
